# Keep these runtime pins aligned with the declared pyproject.toml floors.
# Plotting dependencies must not silently select a newer NumPy for this job.
numpy==1.22.0
scipy==1.9.3

# Matplotlib 3.7 uses parser APIs deprecated by newer pyparsing versions.
# Keep its plotting test warning-free without constraining library users or
# the current, locked development/documentation environment.
pyparsing<3.3
